text:
Iris: Observed an uptick in 5xx from v2 on mobile after tonight's canary shift to 30%. Appears tied to clients without the new header. Can we pause and pin affected tenants?

deploy-bot: Trigger: v2 canary -> 30% (r-7034). Started 1778887500. Error-rate alert @1778887620.

Nate: Pausing canary now: `deploy-bot pause --release r-7034 --route mobile-canary`

deploy-bot: Canary paused for mobile-canary. Tagging: paused-mobile-1778887776.

Jules: Quick triage: router rule requires `X-Client-Version`. Some background sync calls strip it. Gateway should fallback to v1 when header missing. I'll push a short-lived rule for mobile UA.

Iris: Also add tenant-level pins for key customers hitting errors: `opal-inc` and `horizon-labs`. ops-bot?

ops-bot: Pinning tenants: `ops-bot pin-tenants --release r-7034 --tenants opal-inc,horizon-labs --exclude` -> completed.

Jules: Edge rule applied to NA/EU. Initial metrics look good: mobile error-rate dropped toward baseline in 5m. Monitoring for 20m.

Nate: Drafting release note: "Mobile canary paused due to SDK header behavior; affected tenants pinned to v1; gateway fallback applied. SDK fix in progress." Will push to release-notes/mobile and notify CS.

Iris: Rollback criteria: if error-rate doesn't stabilize in 20m or new errors appear, we'll rollback v2 mobile handler to r-7032: `deploy-bot rollback --release r-7034 --to r-7032 --grace 2m`. Otherwise keep pins + gateway patch until SDK 2.1.3 lands.

Jules: Confirmed stable at 15m. Keeping coercion and pins for now.

Iris: Thanks. Closing thread; SDK and mobile teams looped in.
